text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks after gains of about 11%–26%; the satisfaction was real, but I should avoid treating a gain alone as a reason to sell before considering the stock’s outlook.","When my account fell from its peak, doing nothing avoided impulsive decisions; I should keep reviewing my holdings calmly, without reacting to every monthly change.","After decades of investing, I know my tendency to hold rarely and value realized gains. I should make decisions that fit my long-term needs, while not letting that comfort replace a thoughtful review of risk and potential."]}
